name: Weekly GitHub Dev Summary - Bulletproof Portfolio Edition

parameters.jsCode: const c=$json;const e=[];if(!/^[^/\s]+\/[^/\s]+$/.test(String(c.repo||'')))e.push('repo must be owner/repo');const l=String(c.language||'').toUpperCase();if(!['EN','FR'].includes(l))e.push('language must be EN or FR');const d=Number(c.daysBack);if(!Number.isFinite(d)||d<1||d>31)e.push('daysBack must be 1-31');if(c.enableSuccessDelivery&&!String(c.discordWebhookUrl||'').startsWith('https://discord.com/api/webhooks/'))e.push('Discord webhook required when delivery is enabled');if(e.length)throw new Error('Preflight failed: '+e.join('; '));return [{json:{...c,language:l,daysBack:d}}];

const cfg=$('Configuration').first().json;const commits=$('Fetch Commits').all().map(i=>i.json);const ir=$('Fetch Closed Issues').first().json;const pr=$('Fetch Merged PRs').first().json;if(!Array.isArray(commits)||!Array.isArray(ir.items)||!Array.isArray(pr.items))throw new Error('GitHub contract validation failed');const data={repository:cfg.repo,language:cfg.language,commits:commits.map(c=>({sha:(c.sha||'').slice(0,7),message:(c.commit?.message||'').split('\n')[0],author:c.author?.login||c.commit?.author?.name||'unknown',date:c.commit?.author?.date})),closedIssues:ir.items.map(i=>({number:i.number,title:i.title,closed_at:i.closed_at})),mergedPRs:pr.items.map(p=>({number:p.number,title:p.title,updated_at:p.updated_at}))};const lang=cfg.language==='FR'?'Write in French.':'Write in English.';const prompt=`${lang} Create a factual weekly GitHub engineering report using ONLY this JSON. Use headings: Development Activity; Issues and Pull Requests; Notable Patterns; What to Watch Next. Include chronological commit dates/times when available. Never infer automation, intent, project health, causes, business impact, architecture, or future plans. What to Watch Next must describe comparisons future reports can make, not predictions. Data: ${JSON.stringify(data)}`;return [{json:{...data,prompt,discordWebhookUrl:cfg.discordWebhookUrl,enableSuccessDelivery:cfg.enableSuccessDelivery}}];

options.systemMessage: Use only supplied GitHub data. Never invent causes, intent, project health, automation, architecture, business impact, or future plans. Describe visible patterns only. Do not predict. Preserve counts, authors, dates, UTC timestamps, exact commit messages, issue/PR numbers and titles. Accuracy outranks insight.

parameters.jsCode: const a=$('AI Agent - Weekly Summary').first().json;const o=a.output??a.text??a.response;if(typeof o!=='string'||o.trim().length<80)throw new Error('AI output missing or too short');for(const h of ['Development Activity','Issues and Pull Requests','Notable Patterns','What to Watch Next'])if(!o.includes(h))throw new Error('AI output missing section: '+h);return [{json:{report:o}}];

const s=$('Build and Validate Brief').first().json;const r=$('Validate AI Report').first().json.report;return [{json:{webhookUrl:s.discordWebhookUrl,body:{username:'Weekly GitHub Dev Summary',embeds:[{title:`Weekly Dev Summary — ${s.repository}`,description:r.slice(0,4000),footer:{text:'Bulletproof portfolio edition — Claude Sonnet 4 via OpenRouter'},timestamp:new Date().toISOString()}]}}}];
